restaurant_name: ทันตกรรมสีขาว White Dental Clinic
text:
First of all, I must say that this clinic is the best dental clinic I've ever been to in my almost 70 years of life.
Above all, it's the skill of the dentists here. They are incredibly talented. Before treatment, they make accurate diagnoses. During treatment, it's incredibly comfortable; there's no pain or discomfort, just pure relaxation—sometimes I even fall asleep. After treatment, there are never any problems; I never need any touch-ups. I want to whisper that Dr. Chai is incredibly kind. Sometimes he even sings softly while treating me, which helps me avoid stress. Honestly, I trust and have complete faith in Dr. Chai's skills. No other dentist is allowed to touch my mouth!
The facility and equipment are very modern. Dr. Jim constantly studies, procures, and introduces the latest and most advanced equipment to the clinic. This not only speeds up treatment times but also ensures high-quality results and enhances the cleanliness and sterilization of the clinic.
The price is comparable to other high-quality clinics. I've never considered it expensive considering the quality of treatment before, during, and after.
The staff are polite, well-mannered, highly skilled, and experienced.
The place is spacious, clean, and comfortably air-conditioned. There's a comfortable, uncrowded waiting area. It's conveniently located for both private cars and public transportation, such as the Yellow Line Skytrain.
There's ample covered parking; no need to compete for spaces. It's also protected from the sun and rain. There are charging stations for electric vehicles.

They're clearly experienced and they use cutting-edge 3D-scanning technology too. Reasonable prices. Really recommend this dental practice.
